verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair openness question for an agentic coding platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows a downloadable desktop client (docs-36) and remote control of desktop sessions on your own machines (docs-26). Nothing shows the core product, including its agent backend and model serving, can be deployed on user-controlled infrastructure. Community reports of model quota limits and account entitlement requirements point to a vendor-hosted dependency rather than a self-hostable product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
